articles.summary: On 5 October 2023, an investigation was initiated by the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) into the supply of public cloud infrastructure services in the UK. The investigation follows a referral from Ofcom, which identified potential competition concerns within the cloud services market. articles.title: CRA advises AWS on CMA’s cloud services market investigation
